description: Create the Scene005 foundation: NetworkEngine, NeighborhoodManager, InfluenceGraph, and ConstellationHints modules in js/engine/universe/. Add NETWORK_STATES, NEIGHBORHOOD_STATES constants, scene005 settings block, and the Scene005_LivingNetwork scene class with Scene005Phases.
steps: Add new constants to js/config/constants.js: NETWORK_STATES (Object.freeze with SEED, GROWING, STABLE, EXPANDING), NEIGHBORHOOD_STATES (Object.freeze with FORMING, ALIGNED, COORDINATED, DISPERSING), and add NETWORK to TIMELINE_CHAPTERS.

Add scene005 settings block to js/config/settings.js following the exact pattern of scene004 (Object.freeze). Include: network (maxNodes: 64, maxEdges: 128, influenceDecay: 0.995, edgeFormationThreshold: 0.15, edgeMaxAge: 30), neighborhood (maxNeighborhoods: 4, alignmentRadius: 80, coordinationThreshold: 0.3, disperseTimeout: 8, updateInterval: 12), constellationHints (maxFilaments: 4, avgVisible: 2, maxOpacity: 0.07, fadeInDuration: 2.0, fadeOutDuration: 1.5, minLifetime: 3, maxLifetime: 6, spawnInterval: 4, seed: 739), phases (isolation: {start:0, duration:5}, influence: {start:5, duration:7}, alignment: {start:12, duration:6}, neighborhood: {start:18, duration:7}, possibility: {start:25, duration:5}), environment (warmthIncrease: 0.03, fogBreathSpeedMult: 1.2, densityLift: 0.03), camera (broadenSpeed: 0.2, patternTrackWeight: 0.05, maxBroadenRadius: 6, reducedMotionFactor: 0.2).

Create js/engine/universe/InfluenceGraph.js: A reusable invisible graph data structure. Pre-allocated node pool (maxNodes from settings) with {particleIndex, influenceWeight, connectionAge, active}. Pre-allocated edge pool (maxEdges) with {nodeA, nodeB, weight, age, active}. Methods: init(), addNode(particleIndex), addEdge(nodeA, nodeB, weight), updateEdges(deltaTime) to age edges and decay weights, getNodeCount(), getEdgeCount(), getEdgesForNode(nodeIndex), destroy(). Zero per-frame allocations. Uses MANAGER_STATES lifecycle.

Create js/engine/universe/NeighborhoodManager.js: Detects small groups (2-6 particles) behaving similarly within influence regions. Uses spatial hashing (like ClusterDetection pattern). Pre-allocated neighborhood pool (maxNeighborhoods from settings). Each neighborhood: {particleIndices: Int32Array(8), count, state: NEIGHBORHOOD_STATES, timer, avgVx, avgVy, active}. Methods: init(maxParticles), update(particles, activeCount, deltaTime, influenceEngine), detectNeighborhoods(...), updateNeighborhoods(...), getActiveCount(), destroy(). updateInterval from settings. Coordination = velocity alignment without explicit connection. Reduced motion: skip velocity alignment, use opacity coordination instead.

Create js/engine/universe/NetworkEngine.js: Top-level network orchestrator. Owns InfluenceGraph and NeighborhoodManager instances. Responsibilities: maintain invisible graph, track neighborhoods, measure local density (simple count of particles within influence radius / area), predict future expansion (based on neighborhood count trend). Methods: init(width, height, maxParticles), update(particles, activeCount, deltaTime, influenceEngine), seedFromConnection(midX, midY, indexA, indexB), getLocalDensity(x, y), getNeighborhoodCount(), getGraphMetrics(), destroy(). This is INVISIBLE - no rendering. Pure data architecture for future community/marketplace/trust systems.

Create js/engine/universe/ConstellationHints.js: Renders max 4 extremely faint temporary filaments on the CONSTELLATIONS layer. Uses ConnectionRenderer internally for each hint filament. Pre-allocated pool of 4 hint objects: {indexA, indexB, opacity, targetOpacity, lifetime, maxLifetime, active, fadePhase('in'|'hold'|'out')}. Spawning logic: noise-driven timer (spawnInterval + variation), picks two particles from InfluenceGraph edges that are close but NOT the main connection pair. Opacity NEVER exceeds 0.07 (below 8%). Average visible: 1-2 at any time. fadeIn over 2s, hold briefly, fadeOut over 1.5s. They vanish before the viewer fully notices. Reduced motion: opacity fades only (no curve displacement in ConnectionRenderer). Methods: init(reducedMotion, mainIndexA, mainIndexB), update(deltaTime, elapsedTime, influenceGraph, particles, activeCount), render(ctx, particles, deltaTime, reducedMotion), destroy().

Create js/scenes/scene005/Scene005Phases.js following Scene004Phases.js pattern. 5 emotional phases: Isolation (0-5s - silence, the scene holds its breath after Scene004 warmth), Influence (5-12s - NetworkEngine seeds from connection, influence graph begins growing invisibly, first neighborhood detection starts), Alignment (12-18s - particles in neighborhoods begin coordinating velocity subtly, first constellation hints may appear), Neighborhood (18-25s - neighborhoods solidify briefly then disperse, more constellation hints fade in/out, camera notices patterns), Possibility (25-30s - environmental warmth increases ~3%, scene completes). Total duration: 30s. Export SCENE005_DURATION = 30.

Create js/scenes/Scene005_LivingNetwork.js following Scene004_Ripple.js pattern exactly. Scene ID: 'scene005_livingNetwork'. Owns: NetworkEngine, InfluenceEngine (re-used from Scene004 pattern), BehaviorSystem (with curiosity still active), SynchronizationSystem, ConnectionRenderer (for ONE persistent connection), ConstellationHints, AudioArchitecture, SceneDirector. setConnectionData(midX, midY, indexA, indexB) receives connection data. enter() initializes all subsystems. keepConstellationsLayer() renders BOTH the ONE persistent filament AND the constellation hints. update() delegates to director and subsystems. Phase callbacks: activateNetworkSeed(), activateNeighborhoods(), activateConstellationHints(), activateEnvironmentalWarmth(), markCompleted(). leave() tears down. Accessibility: reducedMotion flag propagated to all subsystems.
acceptance_criteria: All new files pass node --check syntax validation
js/config/constants.js exports NETWORK_STATES and NEIGHBORHOOD_STATES as frozen objects
js/config/settings.js exports scene005 config block with all specified sub-objects
NetworkEngine.js is under 400 lines with no function over 60 lines
NeighborhoodManager.js is under 400 lines with zero per-frame allocations
InfluenceGraph.js is under 400 lines with pre-allocated pools
ConstellationHints.js enforces max 4 filaments, max 0.07 opacity
Scene005_LivingNetwork.js follows the exact same structural pattern as Scene004_Ripple.js
verification: Run NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check on each new file: InfluenceGraph.js, NeighborhoodManager.js, NetworkEngine.js, ConstellationHints.js, Scene005_LivingNetwork.js, Scene005Phases.js
